text_block_list.text: On the way back from finishing some errands with Mejiro McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Today, there is a matter of great importance
that I would like you to accompany me with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Um... I did mention before that I enjoy movies, did I not?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Today... I was hoping you could accompany me
with something else. M-Meaning...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't possibly put it into words!
Would you please come with me?"
I gave a nod with a smile and decided to follow along.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Here we are. The truth is...
I simply adore this place.
choice_data_list: Is this place... an amusement park?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, that is not it. If only it were
such an adorable hobby, how wonderful that would be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What I love isn't the amusement park,
but that place right next to it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Listen, can you hear it?
All these cheers.

Cheers could be heard from the domed stadium on the grounds.
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I absolutely love watching baseball.
Especially live at the stadium!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Watching from behind the centerfield screen, I couldn't help but
let out some rather unrefined cheers."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed... Things like, 'Hit it, Yutaka!' and all that. Before I knew it, my tail was wagging, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I understand completely. That this is
conduct unbecoming of a daughter of Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, when I see my beloved team, the Victories,
fiercely fighting on the field... Aaaahh!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am... not quite fine, it seems.
I got a bit too carried away talking...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I simply cannot sit still any longer!
Trainer, please come watch the race with me right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "I had faith that you would say so."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Then please, come with me.
Right this way!

Mejiro McQueen instinctively grabbed my hand
and started running. She seemed overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I got completely carried away.
Um... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I must have surprised you, haven't I?
With my uncharacteristic behavior while watching the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I just can't help getting fired up.
Like, feeling all that power burning in my gut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Next time... I would like you to shout with me.
It is rather embarrassing being the only one heard, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I absolutely adore those!
I always end up spinning it around like a little kid.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I would love to spin it together with you next time, Trainer.
I will teach you as thanks for everything you do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still... how wonderful. To think someone
would actually come watch baseball with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to share the joy and excitement of victory
like this on our walk home... it feels like a dream..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I took the plunge and invited you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A battery...? My, are we
a pitcher and a catcher?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that is certainly true. Tossing our feelings
back and forth between the two of us like this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still, now that you've said it, please don't forget.
If we are a battery, our fates are tied together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I want you to accept all of my secrets.
Even my... most shameful feelings.
With those words, Mejiro McQueen lightly averts her eyes. It seems there's still something she can't quite bring herself to say.
